name: accordion
description: A source-owned shadcn-style Accordion for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styled facade over the owned roving-focus collapsible-group primitive (reuses the collection infrastructure already imported for Select). Composes a Lucide ChevronDown indicator into the trigger, matching shadcn's Accordion.
documentation.accessibility: Each `AccordionTrigger` is a native `<button>` with `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` pointing at its `AccordionContent` (`packages/adico-primitives/src/accordion.rs`). `Accordion`/`AccordionMulti` implement the WAI-ARIA APG Accordion pattern's single- vs. multiple-open-panel variants.
documentation.keyboard: Triggers share a single-tab-stop roving tabindex: arrow keys move focus along the accordion, Home/End jump to the first/last trigger, Enter/Space (native button activation) toggles the focused panel.
